$comment: TEST FIXTURE — deliberately invalid. A third-level profile that takes the tag its grandparent already uses. Rule ids are local, so the tag is the only thing that has to be unique along a chain: with two 'interface-disclosure' tags in one family, the citation interface-disclosure#I1 names two different rules. The validator must reject this with exit code 3, and C15 must fail. Not a real profile; do not copy.
title: Colliding tag profile (test fixture)

objective.consumer: A fixture, standing in for a consumer.
objective.decision: Whether the validator rejects a tag already used by an ancestor.
